name: Barrel
description: A wooden barrel. Cover to hide behind, and easily smashed.

name: Chest
description: An iron-bound chest, too heavy to move or break.

name: Barricade
description: Planks and crates piled high: blocks arrows and spells until it is hacked apart.

name: Pillar
description: Solid stone. Blocks movement and line of sight, and does not break.

name: Crate
description: A sturdy crate: cover that takes a few blows to break.

name: Boulder
description: A great rock. Blocks movement and line of sight, and does not break.

name: Statue
description: A stone figure on a plinth. Blocks movement and line of sight, and does not break.

name: Stone Block
description: A squared block of masonry: waist-high cover you can shoot over, and it does not break.

name: Table
description: A heavy wooden table. Gets in the way, but arrows fly over it, and a few blows break it.

name: Bookshelf
description: A tall shelf of books: blocks arrows and spells until it is smashed apart.

name: Well
description: A stone well. Blocks movement but not sight, and does not break.

name: Standing Torch
description: An iron torch stand. Thin enough to see past; knocked over with a single blow.

name: Coffin
description: A wooden coffin, lid nailed shut. Low cover that takes a few blows to break.

name: Skull Pile
description: A heap of old bones. In the way, but it scatters with a kick or two.

name: Altar
description: A carved stone altar. Blocks movement but not sight, and does not break.

name: Campfire
description: A cookfire with a pot over it. Nobody walks through it, but you can see across it.

name: Rock
description: A knee-high rock: in the way, but you can see and shoot over it. It does not break.

name: Rubble
description: A heap of fallen stone. Nobody walks through it, but it hides nothing.

name: Stalagmite
description: A spire of dripstone. Thin enough to see past; it takes a while to break.

name: Lantern Post
description: A crooked post with a lantern on it. One blow knocks it down.

name: Pit
description: A dark hole in the floor. Nobody walks over it, but you can see and shoot across.

name: Lava Pool
description: Molten rock. Impassable, but it hides nothing.

name: Snowdrift
description: A bank of packed snow: in the way until someone digs through it.

name: Ice Spike
description: A jagged spike of ice. Brittle: a few blows shatter it.

name: Lava Rock
description: A smouldering lump of volcanic rock. Impassable, and it does not break.

name: Forge
description: A smith's forge, still warm. Blocks movement but not sight, and does not break.

name: Anvil
description: A heavy iron anvil: low cover that will not move or break.

name: Throne
description: A high-backed throne. Blocks movement but not sight, and does not break.

name: Cabinet
description: A tall wooden cabinet: blocks arrows and spells until it is smashed.

name: Candelabra
description: A tall iron candle stand. Easy to see past, and to knock over.

name: Pew
description: A long wooden bench: low cover that a few blows break.

name: Broken Statue
description: What is left of a statue: too low to hide behind, too heavy to break.

name: Weapon Rack
description: A rack of old weapons. In the way, and breaks with a few blows.
